info.title: Poly IA commissioning bootstrap
info.description: Authenticated command service bound to loopback behind an exact public HTTPS origin. Native programs use a bounded typed interpreter; intake retains source spans; Astra, rasm and structured forms use explicit versions. Constructive generators return exact bounded candidates and evidence. No model inference or full-mission acceptance is claimed. Global connection admission returns 429/503; logs use fixed categories without user content.

servers.description: Same-origin service or explicitly configured HTTPS reverse proxy

200.description: Static interface; contains no authentication token or ledger state

get.summary: Read the current durable state envelope

get.description: after is exclusive. Resume using next_after; an empty page preserves the supplied cursor. Feed is JSON polling, not SSE or WebSocket.

post.summary: Apply or recover one authenticated command
post.description: Requires Content-Length, application/json (optional charset=utf-8), at most 65536 body bytes, unique object keys, finite numbers and outer HTTP JSON depth at most 32. Experiment parameters separately have depth at most 12, 2048 values and 2048 characters per ordinary string, with existing native/intake source and exact rasm-recovery exceptions. The exact forms deserialize envelope additionally permits only its top-level text up to 49152 UTF-8 bytes; all depth/value limits remain, and the entire canonical ASCII-JSON command must still fit 65536 bytes. Generators/forms retain these ordinary input limits and have a 524288-byte canonical ASCII JSON report cap, independent of their larger standalone kernel bounds. Fixed HTTP actor is operator. A 200 receipt means the operation was recorded; inspect result for scientific/verifier status and nested original capability reports.

200.description: Committed receipt, including exact idempotent retries

409.description: Revision, idempotency, integrity, or state transition conflict

get.description: Looks up IDs across actors; AMBIGUOUS_COMMAND (409) is returned if the same ID belongs to multiple actors. Unknown IDs return 404.
Returns NOT_FOUND (404) until a checkpoint exists.

get.summary: Recompute ledger, artifact and checkpoint integrity
get.description: Read operation; 200 can contain ok:false with diagnostics. It never repairs corruption.

get.summary: Read separate ledger command refusal diagnostics
get.description: HTTP prevalidation and authentication failures are not retained in this ledger refusal journal. Refusals do not advance revision.

Private read for operator or read bearer. Does not alter ledger revision. Exactly one offset and limit are allowed; numeric values use 1–19 ASCII decimal digits. Offset equal to total_size returns an empty terminal chunk. Follow next_offset until null and decode base64 to reconstruct exact bytes. No paths, token query parameters, or HTTP Range headers. The complete stored blob is loaded and hash-checked on every request; 64 KiB bounds the returned bytes, not storage memory. Ordinary artifact capture is bounded to 8 MiB per file and 32 MiB per command.

head.description: Same authorization, full blob verification, query validation and status as GET. Content-Length describes the corresponding GET JSON representation. Never returns a body or changes semantic revision.

operatorBearer.description: POLYIA_OPERATOR_TOKEN: read and command authority. Never place it in a URL.

readBearer.description: Optional distinct POLYIA_READ_TOKEN: authenticated reads only.

parameters.description: Bounded registered input. Native requires {source}; intake requires {text}, optional format text/polyia and style concise/tutorial. Astra, rasm and forms require explicit versioned operation envelopes. Generators requires {card,request}, optionally style concise/tutorial; it returns the constructed model, execution and optional first-candidate illustration/curriculum. Forms wraps its complete original report in report.result; an inner UNSUPPORTED is retained while the command report status is REFUSED. Only the original four experiments support {} defaults. All generators/forms requests retain command limits: 65536 body bytes, parameter depth 12, at most 2048 values and 2048 characters per ordinary string. Only the exact forms deserialize envelope (version polyia.forms/0.1, operation deserialize, alphabet, text, optional budgets; no other fields) allows its top-level text up to 49152 UTF-8 bytes. The whole command remains limited to 65536 canonical ASCII-JSON bytes, so escaping can reduce usable text size. Their command reports are limited to 524288 bytes of canonical ASCII JSON. Larger standalone kernel inputs/results are not necessarily admitted by the command service. No ambient host execution.

Command.description: Exactly four top-level fields. Unknown payload fields are refused. The expected revision guards new commands; exact retries recover the original receipt. IDs are actor-scoped.

commission_status.description: The bootstrap never grants blanket full-mission acceptance.

state.description: Reducer state snapshot; revision/head are supplied by the checkpoint envelope.

data.description: At most 65536 decoded bytes; empty at EOF

next_offset.description: Next byte offset, or null at the end of this captured object

x-transport-constraints.origin: absent or exactly matching an allowed request authority; no wildcard CORS
x-transport-constraints.host: bound loopback authority, localhost on bound port, or explicitly configured public_origin
x-transport-constraints.tokens: browser JavaScript memory only; no URL, cookie, localStorage or sessionStorage
x-transport-constraints.request-framing: single Content-Length; no Transfer-Encoding; connection closes after response
x-transport-constraints.response-header: X-PolyIA-Scope: operator or read for authenticated responses
x-transport-constraints.http-refusal-audit: safe response diagnostics; no durable HTTP prevalidation journal

x-evidence.scope: tested finite bootstrap behaviors; deployment and full commission remain separate

generators.description: Compilation failure returns a reason/detail refusal. After compilation the execution retains exact candidates, counts, work and trace. With an explicit style, the first candidate may receive an illustration and polynomial-only curriculum; absent/unsupported views remain null.

forms.result: Complete run_forms report including actual status, checks, identities and limitations. Outer UNSUPPORTED is mapped to REFUSED; the nested original status is preserved.

transport.report_encoding: canonical ASCII JSON; applies to generators/forms report, not the enclosing receipt or accumulated state
transport.scope: Standalone kernel maxima do not expand command admission.

forms_deserialize_text_exception.scope: Only this exact envelope/path; other strings remain at 2048 characters. Entire canonical ASCII-JSON command remains at 65536 bytes; escaped content may reach that limit sooner.
